label: L=9 copy step 11 (input orig[1]=v/p/2/i, outputting orig[2])
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit with tiny magnitudes (max ~0.003 above threshold). It fires only in the copy phase, and almost only in length-9 sequences: 92% of activation mass is at t=11, the step whose input is orig(1) (two steps after <DEL>) and which outputs orig(2). L=9 & t=11 alone reaches mass recall 0.92 but precision 0.02, because only about 2% of such steps fire. Whether it fires depends on which tokens are there. The input orig(1) is most often v, then p, 2 or i (v gives the strongest activations), and firing goes up when orig(0) is q, n, 1 or v. A conjunction of both token sets reaches precision about 0.37 but low recall. There is a small leftover at t=17 (last step of L=9) and at t=10/12. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, never for L<=7, and never on a token occurring for the first time.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=v (+4.02), phase=2 & in_tok=p (+2.89), phase=2 & in_tok=i (+2.71), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+2.62), orig4=c (+2.21), prev_tok=v (+1.86). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.41), orig7=- (-1.60), orig0=z (-1.48), in_first=1 (-1.10).
